text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock D and then buying other positions has not improved my account value; avoid reactive churn and require a clear reason before each trade.","Several sales locked in large losses, while later purchases do not guarantee a recovery; judge each holding by its current outlook and downside risk, not its cost or hope of rebounding.","My account has drifted lower over these periods, so I should track performance against the market over a longer horizon and review whether my decisions—not just market moves—are helping returns."]}
